name: Reonof
source:
A veteran soldier at the CSF.

Reonof fights bravely at the battlefield. His comrades believe he is the god of victory. But outside of combat he is very gentle, tender, and pleasant towards others. His strength is the stuff of legends among CSF personnel. He is Shou and Oumar's senior, and he has known them since they were in training.
